world_story_clues.label: Old bell strike lever
world_story_clues.text: The lever pulls farther than it should. A distant church bell gives one hollow answer across the empty roofs, although nobody stands at its ropes. Nothing appears on the lanes below. The silence after the note is longer than the sound itself.

world_story_clues.label: Listening fissure at mine entrance
world_story_clues.text: At the outer listening crack, a human voice can be heard through stone. Its words are almost recognizable, and its pauses suggest it is waiting for someone to answer. The inner threshold remains sealed. Nothing can be seen beyond it.
